```{python}
import spacy
import pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
from nltk.corpus import wordnet as wn
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import nltk

nltk.download('wordnet')

eng_nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")

spa_nlp = spacy.load("es_core_news_sm")

```

```{python}
def read_book(path):
    with open(path, mode="r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
      return f.read()
  
eng = read_book("../data/english_alice.txt")
spa = read_book("../data/spanish_alice.txt")
print(eng[:200])
print(spa[:200])
```

```{python}
#Step 1 English
eng_nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")

eng_doc = eng_nlp(eng)

eng_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower(), t.pos_) for t in eng_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
                  
#data frame

#defining columns variables
eng_language = "english"
total_eng_tokens = len(eng_doc)
eng_lemmas_count = len(eng_lemmas)
eng_div = eng_lemmas_count / total_eng_tokens
eng_sentence_count = len(list(eng_doc.sents))

#English DF 
eng_df_freq = pd.DataFrame(
    [(eng_language, total_eng_tokens, eng_div, eng_sentence_count)],
    columns=["language", "token count", "diversity", "sentence count"]
)

print(eng_df_freq)
```

```{python}

#Step 1 Spanish
spa_nlp = spacy.load("es_core_news_sm")

spa_doc = spa_nlp(spa)

spa_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower(), t.pos_) for t in spa_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
                  
#data frame

#defining columns variables
spa_language = "spanish"
spa_freq = Counter(spa_lemmas)
total_spa_tokens = len(spa_doc)
spa_lemmas_count = len(spa_lemmas)
spa_div = spa_lemmas_count / total_spa_tokens
spa_sentence_count = len(list(spa_doc.sents))

#English DF 
spa_df_freq = pd.DataFrame(
    [(spa_language, total_spa_tokens, spa_div, spa_sentence_count)],
    columns=["language", "token count", "diversity", "sentence count"]
)

print(spa_df_freq)
```
